## How to take it

Comment "taking this" and wait to be assigned; only the assigned person is paid. If there is no pull request within 7 days, the maintainer unassigns it and the task opens up again. Put `Closes #<this issue>` and `Base address: 0x…` in the pull request description as plain lines (the template has a place for them). Rules: [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/0x94t3z/fieldatlas/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#contributor-rewards).
